purpose: E1 acceptance (GROW_UP_ROOT_DOWN_REVISE_20261113 engineering step E1): every stage-boundary checkpoint of kernel K_v1 resumes to the same episode. Harness check only; no reliability or success counting.
task_choice: Stage-0 near instances chosen from the stage-0 results before any checkpoint episode ran: TP04_near_1130402 (fruit, full chain, verified success), TP04_near_1130406 (fruit, guard stop in lift_and_hold), TP01_near_1130102 (bottle, guard stop in approach; covers the object-recipe path without the fruit leaf).
physical_episodes: one fresh source episode per task plus one resume per written checkpoint (at most 11 per task)
prediction: Every resume reproduces its source episode: integration and boundary state arrays byte-equal; actions, execution, tools, verdict (except trajectory file hash) and result counts equal.
falsification: Any resume with a differing record, or a source episode that raises a checkpoint TypeError/PicklingError. Either blocks E2; the check is repeated only after a code change, in a new output directory.
comparison_note: The fresh source episodes are compared with their own resumes only. They are not compared with the stage-0 episodes, which ran before checkpoints existed and were not rerun.
